name: Social Short
description: Research, plan, generate or compose, validate, review, and optionally publish a vertical social video.

stages.name: research
success_criteria: A topic or supplied source is resolved into a usable brief.

stages.name: plan
success_criteria: The plan names an executable visual path and target 9:16 delivery.

stages.name: generate
success_criteria: Every planned scene has a usable generated or supplied asset.

stages.name: compose
success_criteria: A playable vertical MP4 is produced.

stages.name: validate
success_criteria: Video and expected dimensions are present.
The render is suitable for review before publishing.

stages.name: review
success_criteria: The user explicitly approves the draft before publish.

stages.name: publish
success_criteria: Publishing is attempted only after approval.
